build.description: Rebuild everything this stack runs, even what hasn't changed.

no-build.description: Start without building, even when a build output is missing.

web.description: Use your local SDK and toolkit builds: start the local registry, publish them and point the extensions at them.

no-logs.description: Don't forward logs to Grafana. Terminal and files only.

full.description: Everything on this machine: Docker dependencies, C# hosts, all Scala services, the portal and its extensions.

backend.description: The API only: Docker dependencies, C# hosts and all Scala services. No portal.

csharp-portal.description: C# hosts with the minimal Scala set for login, plus the portal and its extensions.

portal-extensions.description: The portal and its extensions against the remote dev backend. Nothing else runs locally.

web-dev.description: Local SDK and toolkit builds, the portal and its extensions, against the remote dev backend.

non-publish.description: Type-check loop: start the registry, never publish the packages or repoint the extensions.

remote.description: This workspace's microservices and portal extensions, registered against a remote realm and used from the hosted portal.
